rca of the issue:
The submit-sir gating gap exists because in NewInspection.jsx line 351 the button disable expression is only `disabled={loading}` and there is no

element rendered. The `allFilled` variable is computed (line 125) but only used inside submit() to short-circuit on click. Fix: bind disabled to `loading || !allFilled` and render the warning when !allFilled just above the buttons (inside the Card at lines 335-357).
